svg.title: Give-up rescue against its cost on a true outage, per model and wording
svg.desc: Small multiples, one per model. x: calls per request on a true outage; y: give-up-trap success minus control. The shaded corner is W6's RECOMMENDABLE region. Data in rescue_cost.csv.
svg.text: A stated count keeps the rescue at the floor cost
Give-up-trap rescue (vs control) against calls per request on a true outage. Floor: 3 calls. Whiskers: 95% intervals.
calls per request on a true outage (lower is cheaper; the rescue needs 3)
Shaded: RECOMMENDABLE region (rescue ≥ 0.5, at most 3.5 calls)
